posts.text: i exited sugar stocks with no profit and no loss but wasted a lot of time to understanding how this industry functions in india ,to never in sugar industries. both your buying price and selling price is controlled by the goverment,the goverment cares about 1 thing and thing only that is his vote bank,which are your farmers and sometimesabout it people who consume sugar.so they put hard caps on both buying and selling ,its extermely difficult for sugar companies to make super normal profits in a cycle ,not only that if they wanted to export it’s sugar there are hard caps on it as well.
